directory_policies.notes.4: English policy: Non-native F-1/J-1 applicants must provide TOEFL, IELTS or DET taken within two years; prior English-medium education does not itself earn a waiver. Complete numerical/format rules still need review.
directory_policies.notes.5: GRE policy: GRE is required and must be under five years old; the at-home test is accepted. The CMU-undergraduate exception needs manual review.

source_excerpt: The GRE At Home test is accepted
fact_summary: The program confirms GRE format and age together with English-test and waiver policies; this does not invent a numerical language minimum.
